title: Smart Data Models - RealEstateCore - Room
description: A room within a building (rec:Room, RealEstateCore 4.1; REC gives no definition of its own). Modelled generically: the specific room type -- 95 classes such as Office, ConferenceRoom, CookingRoom, Bedroom, Lobby, OperatingRoom -- is carried in recClass rather than as 95 separate entity types.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Room'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Human-readable name (REC 'name' in DTDL, rdfs:label in the SHACL source).

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. A description of this item. Not a REC term.

identifiers.description: Property. Map of external identifiers for this entity, keyed by the namespace/system that issued them (REC 'identifiers', DTDL Map<string,string>).

customTags.description: Property. Map of free-form boolean tags (REC 'customTags', DTDL Map<string,boolean>).

customProperties.description: Property. Namespaced extension properties: a map from namespace to a map of property name to string value (REC 'customProperties', DTDL Map<string,Map<string,string>>).

recClass.description: Relationship. The specific RealEstateCore class of this entity (rdf:type), as the class IRI. REC 4.1 declares 95 non-deprecated classes in the rec:Room hierarchy (this class and all its subclasses), all allowed here: AdmittingRoom; Atrium; Auditorium; BackOffice; BarRoom; Bathroom; Bedroom; BicycleGarage; Cabinet; CableRoom; CafeteriaRoom; Cinema; Classroom; CleaningRoom; ClimateControlRoom (Climate-control room); CloakRoom; ConferenceRoom; ConversationRoom; CookingRoom; CopyingRoom; DataServerRoom; DiningRoom; DisabledToilet; DishingRoom; DressingRoom; EducationalRoom; ElectricityRoom; ElevatorRoom; ElevatorShaft; Entrance; ExerciseRoom; ExhibitionRoom; FittingRoom; FoodHandlingRoom (Food-handling room); Garage; GroupRoom; Hallway; HealthcareRoom; Kitchenette; Laboratory; LaboratoryDry (Laboratory (dry)); LaboratoryWet (Laboratory (wet)); LaundryRoom; Library; LivingRoom; LoadingReceivingRoom (Loading/receiving room); Lobby; LockerRoom; Lounge; MailRoom; MainEntrance; MeditationRoom; Morgue; MothersRoom (Mothers' room); MultiPurposeRoom (Multi-purpose room); NeonatalNursingRoom; Office; OfficeLandscape; OfficeRoom; OperatingRoom; OutpatientServicesRoom; Pantry; PersonalHygiene (Personal hygiene room); PharmacyRoom; PhoneBooth; RadiologyRoom; Reception; RecordingRoom; RecreationalRoom; RestingRoom; RetailRoom; Room; Sauna; SecurityRoom; ServiceEntrance; ServiceShaft; Shelter; ShelterGasLock; ShelterRoom; ShowerRoom; SmallStudyRoom; SprinklerRoom; StaffRoom; Stairwell; Storage; TeamRoom; TelecommunicationRoom; Theater; TherapyRoom; Toilet; TreatmentRoom; TreatmentWaitingRoom; UtilitiesRoom; WasteManagementRoom; Workshop.

location.description: GeoProperty. GeoJSON geometry of the item (RFC 7946). Corresponds to REC's 'geometry' (a GeoJSON Geometry; 'Polygon representing the spatial extent of this Space' / 'the position or extent of the asset'), carried in the NGSI-LD core 'location' attribute instead of a separate Geometry information object.

hasPart.description: Relationship. Sub-spaces of this space (rec:Space): a Site has Buildings, a Building has Levels, a Level has Rooms, a Zone groups Rooms, etc.

isPartOf.description: Relationship. The single space (rec:Space) this space is part of (SHACL maxCount 1).

isLocationOf.description: Relationship. Things located in this space (e.g. Assets), as URIs. Inverse of Asset.locatedIn.

country.description: Property. Country name, or an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code such as 'SE', 'US' (rec:country).

address.description: Property. Physical postal address of the architecture (rec:address -> rec:PostalAddress). REC models the address as a separate information object; here it is inlined with REC's own field names.

area.description: Property. Business-relevant area measurements (rec:area -> rec:ArchitectureArea), inlined. REC deliberately leaves the unit and measurement standard to the deployment ('as the exact requirements on these measurements will vary from case to case or jurisdiction to jurisdiction'); square metres (MTK) are recommended.

maxOccupancy.description: Property. Maximum occupancy, e.g. per building code (rec:maxOccupancy).

capacity.description: Property. Business-relevant capacity measurements (rec:capacity -> rec:ArchitectureCapacity), inlined.

containsElement.description: Relationship. BuildingElements contained in this space.

adjacentElement.description: Relationship. BuildingElements adjacent to this space.

hasPoint.description: Relationship. Brick Points (sensors, setpoints, commands...) associated with this space -- see the brick-schema candidate's Point and sensor models.

isFedBy.description: Relationship. Equipment or systems that feed this space (e.g. an HVAC unit supplying air).

architectedBy.description: Relationship. Agents (Organization/Person) that designed this architecture.

constructedBy.description: Relationship. Agents that constructed this architecture.

operatedBy.description: Relationship. Agents that operate this architecture.

ownedBy.description: Relationship. Agents that own this architecture.

documentation.description: Relationship. Documents describing this entity (rec:Document, e.g. manuals, drawings, contracts), as URIs.
